subject: 昌珠寺 · 入口正面与金顶（现状）
name: 昌珠寺
sub: 入口正面与金顶 · 吐蕃创建 · 多期重修
yearNote: 传为松赞干布于7世纪创建（国保名单备注“传为七世纪建”）；1351年修复扩建，今天的规模在14世纪基本定型，五世达赖时加金顶、七世达赖时再扩；文革中部分建筑被毁，1980年代重修、1988年重新开光。所绘为现状正面，年表取7世纪的约略定位。
place: 西藏 · 山南 · 乃东 · 昌珠
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q601022（昌珠寺）P625 坐标 29.19373, 91.77181，寺院本体近似坐标，非本项目测绘；地图显示点新建 xz_tradruk。
lede: 雅砻河谷里的昌珠寺，传为松赞干布所建、吐蕃最早的佛堂之一；最里面那间小殿据说仍是当年原殿的位置。今天的格局在14世纪帕竹时期定型，五世达赖时加了金顶，文革后于1980年代重修。白墙、赭红边玛墙、正中一座鎏金汉式屋顶，站在寺前广场就能看全。
facts: 年代：传为松赞干布于7世纪主持修建，为吐蕃时期最早的佛堂之一；1351年修复扩建，五世达赖时加金顶，七世达赖时再扩；1961年列第一批国保。
格局：寺占地4667平方米，措钦大殿面阔、进深均为三间，周围环列12座神殿；最内一间小殿相传仍在松赞干布原殿的位置上。
重修：文化大革命中部分建筑被毁，1980年代重修，1988年重新开光；镇寺之宝是相传文成公主所制、以数千颗珍珠绣成的唐卡。

structure_checkpoints: 正面为一字排开的白色石砌殿墙，墙顶一律是平直的赭红色边玛墙带（白点饰）；中央入口门楼略高、略凸，门洞上悬白色流苏帘与黑底白纹门帘（吉祥结、法轮），门楼顶上立一根黄色宝幢。
门楼后方升起主殿上部：赭红边玛墙上一座鎏金汉式歇山式金顶，正中立法轮双鹿，两侧各一鎏金宝幢圆筒。
门楼左右各接一段低矮白墙殿身：左段有一入口（带帘与遮阳伞处）、顶上一根黄色宝幢；右段有一门洞挂白帘，顶上两根黄色宝幢；最左端为更高的二层白墙体量，开一黑框窗，屋顶有经幡杆与旗杆（旗帜去除）。
整体平顶藏式殿身，只有中央主殿顶上一座金顶；无坡屋顶、无汉式檐廊。
material_observations: 墙面白色石砌、抹灰粗糙；边玛墙带赭红、白点饰；门帘黑底白纹、流苏帘白色；金顶与宝幢圆筒鎏金；布制宝幢明黄色；广场铺灰色石板。
author: Gerd Eichmann

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the front of Tradruk Temple (昌珠寺), Nedong, Shannan, as seen straight-on from its forecourt in Image 2; Image 3 is an oblique view for proportions. Draw one continuous flat-roofed Tibetan front: whitewashed stone walls topped everywhere by a straight dark parapet band. In the middle a slightly taller and projecting entrance pavilion with a fringed valance and a banner over its doorway and ONE cylindrical banner finial on its roof; behind it the main hall rises one level higher and carries a single gilded Chinese-style hip-and-gable roof with a dharma wheel and two deer at its centre and one cylindrical finial at each side. Left and right of the entrance pavilion are lower white wall sections, each with a simple doorway (the right one hung with a white curtain) and cylindrical banner finials on their roofs (one at left, two at right); at the far left a taller plain two-storey white block with one small window. Keep the parapets straight and flat — the only sloping roof is the small gilded roof over the central hall. Remove the flag, flagpole, market stalls, umbrellas, people, vehicles, trees and clouds.
Orientation: landscape 1536×1024.
